homonyms.basis: No homonym on the rail: every card is NewsGuard's and bears on NewsGuard. The name's neighbours are kept as distinct entities, never senses of the center (the task's statement and the Capture Registry's finding, CAP-1-03): the AI False Claim Monitor, the center's series (census row newsguard-ai-false-claim-monitor, relation has_part), composed in its own row; NewsGuard's commercial products, False Claim Fingerprints, Brand Misinformation Monitoring, Source Reliability Ratings and NewsGuard for AI (B2, B3, B5); NewsGuard itself, the company and its browser extension (B6). The MMRS record carries no disambiguation field for this entity. Outside the rail: NewsGuard runs other trackers under similar names, the 2024 Election Misinformation Tracking Center (a press release found by WebSearch, 2026-10-29) and the trackers in its site navigation (B1.txt), distinct entities.

captures.description: NEWSGUARD'S AI TRACKING CENTER, BY NAME, ON GOOGLE'S AI OVERVIEW, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-29: 'an ongoing investigative project by NewsGuard that monitors and catalogs artificial intelligence-generated misinformation, unreliable AI news sites, and AI tool vulnerabilities'; 3,749 AI content farms in 16 languages; chatbots repeating false claims in 28% to over 33% of prompts and failing to recognize AI video in 78% to 95%; 67% of top news sites blocking AI crawlers; and three tools: the False Claims Monitor, False Claim Fingerprints and Brand Misinformation Monitoring. Five cards, all NewsGuard's.
